altText: Taylor Swift in the news: Taylor Swift issued 'would be the greatest performance ever' verdict amid ‘fake’ New York Knicks fan drama
body:
nobody asked for a Taylor-designed tailgate stage and now it's all i want 😂

on the nov. 11 episode of New Heights, Jason said the problem with most tailgates is there's no stage, then asked, "Do you know anybody who knows anything about stages?"

Travis: "Yeah, I actually do. I'll see what my wife can cook up."

it was a joke on a podcast, not an announcement, and Taylor hasn't said a word about it. but the woman behind the Eras Tour, getting volunteered for a tailgate whose last stage hosted sumo wrestling and hobby-horse events? my brain is already building it.

which friend are you dragging to this imaginary tailgate 💛

photo: via SPORTbible

https://www.longlivets.com/?item=vault-tloas-ill-see-what-my-wife-can-cook-up-travis-volunteers-taylor-fo&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat

why: Calendar 11-25 NEWS RESERVE #1: events.uncovered[] empty and neither new-on-site moment is an uncovered 48h event (the CMA performance shipped 11-21; the Big Machine moment is 2006 history), so the named fallback is drafted exactly as written. Source: seed moment showgirl-new-heights-tailgate-stage-joke (supabase/seed/content/the-life-of-a-showgirl.mjs), Travis on his own show, New Heights ep. 211, Nov. 11, 2026, via Complex and ClutchPoints/Yahoo; quotes copied exactly from that record, which also says it was a joke, not a plan, and Taylor has said nothing. Photo: the beat pick wikimedia-22985355 failed the same-picture check and this themed family needs photoEra; the-life-of-a-showgirl pool is exhausted, so this is the press-photo pool next pick, a current close-up of Taylor (checked by eye), the nearest thing to a Showgirl-era photo.

critique.rationale: Opens on the joy of an unrequested gift, then the full sourced exchange and the honest caveat that it was a joke. The share hook comes from the post itself; The photo is a current close-up of Taylor, loosely tied to the story.
